sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official airport accessibility pages. Each item is { "airportCode": "SFO", "url": "https://..." }.

useBrowser.title: Use a real browser
useBrowser.description: Crawl with Playwright instead of plain HTTP. Turn on for sites that block simple requests (CHS returned 403).

ingestUrl.title: Convex ingest URL
ingestUrl.description: https://<deployment>.convex.site/ingest. Leave empty to only write the Apify dataset.

ingestSecret.title: Ingest secret
ingestSecret.description: Must match INGEST_SECRET in the Convex deployment environment.
